question: What is the meaning of quality assessment in relation to product operational aspects?
description: Quality assessment in relation to product operational aspects involves evaluating the performance of the product based on testing, type calculation, tabulated values, or documentation that describes the product. It also includes initial inspection of the manufacturing plant and factory production control, continuing surveillance and evaluation of factory production control, periodic inspections, and verification of specific tasks related to the assessment of performance and conformity with applicable product requirements.
